page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance is equipped with two NVIDIA P100 graphics processing units, delivering a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the server includes a 944 GB SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the integration of dedicated compute cores, local SSD storage, and dual enterprise-grade GPUs on a single instance provides a dense resource profile for parallel processing workloads. This configuration is suitable for deep learning training, high-performance computing, GPU-accelerated databases, and complex scientific simulations.
